---
title: The catalog API
description: Read current templates and their manifests as JSON.
---

The public address is `https://cubeship.dev/api/v1`. Read endpoints need no key and allow requests from any origin.

| Endpoint | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /templates?q&cursor&limit` | Search by directory, display name or README description. `limit` is 1 to 48; `next_cursor` pages results. |
| `GET /templates/{owner}/{repo}` | One template, including README, YAML source, source URL and normalized manifest. New templates use owner `cubeshipd` and the directory name as `repo`. |
| `GET /templates/{owner}/{repo}/manifest` | The current normalized manifest. |
| `GET /icons/{repository}/{commit}.png` | The validated icon at an immutable commit address. |
| `GET /tags` | An empty list; the route remains for older clients. |

The `title` in a listing comes from top-level `name` in `template.yaml`. The `release` object remains in JSON for older instance clients; its `commit` is the source commit, not a selectable version. The catalog serves one current template per directory.

```bash
curl -s 'https://cubeship.dev/api/v1/templates?q=umami'
```

Errors use `{ "error": { "code": "not_found", "message": "..." } }`. Codes are `invalid_query` (400), `not_found` (404) and `unavailable` (503).
